Players Committee card image of [[Slight Weapons Malfunction (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Take a Rebel stormtrooper into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a weapon destiny targeting a stormtrooper (or Chewie). OR If a stormtrooper just fired a weapon (except a lightsaber) during battle, add one battle destiny.” Uploaded unchanged.
